cohort: 921 women delivering between 15 to 35 years old at D. Ruth K. M. Pfau Civil Hospital Karachi from November 2020 to October 2021, divided into adolescent (15-19 years) and adult (20-35 years) groups.
finding: Adolescent pregnancy is associated with adverse fetomaternal outcomes like anemia, preterm delivery, sepsis, eclampsia, and poor perinatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery rate was 24.4% among adolescents.
